register_purpose: Every question that must be answered before a decision is reasonable, with what we know, what we do not know, and the evidence that would settle it.

rows.question: What are the 2026 records, points for and points against through Week 9?
rows.decision_blocked: Anything that depends on team strength: ratings, own lines, seeding.
rows.known: Answered. All 32 teams reconcile field by field between the archive and NFL.com: W-L-T, PF, PA and tie percentage. 136 games played.

rows.question: Which 14 games are in Week 10, when do they kick off, and who is on bye?
rows.decision_blocked: Generating any line without knowing the slate.
rows.known: Answered. 14 games Nov 12-16; byes are CHI, DEN, PHI and TB; kickoff times and networks captured.

rows.question: How does the NFL compute winning percentage with ties?
rows.decision_blocked: Reconciling standings; a naive formula falsely flags two teams.
rows.known: Answered. NFL.com uses (W + T/2) / G: NYG 5-2-1 = 0.688, WAS 2-5-1 = 0.313. A W/G formula yields 0.625 and 0.250 and would report two false mismatches.

rows.question: Does any official NFL source publish betting lines?
rows.decision_blocked: Whether a line can ever be labelled 'official'.
rows.known: Partially answered. No NFL betting lines were found on the NFL.com pages reviewed (standings, schedule, scores, stats, injuries, news), and the 2026 archive contains zero closing lines. The NFL.com terms page was located but has not been legally reviewed, so this is a bounded finding, not proof that no odds publication exists anywhere.
rows.missing: A definitive licensing statement from the NFL about odds redistribution.
rows.evidence_needed: Written confirmation from the NFL or a licensed distributor.

rows.question: Does the NFL publish an official depth chart (starter / 2nd / 3rd / 4th string)?
rows.decision_blocked: The requested defensive backup-deficiency index; any claim that a player is a starter.
rows.known: Answered for the URL tested. https://www.nfl.com/teams/kansas-city-chiefs/depth-chart returns '404 - Flag on the Play'. No official depth chart was located on NFL.com. Starter/backup labels are therefore left blank except where official news explicitly names a change.
rows.missing: An official depth-chart or snap-count publication, if one exists in another location.
rows.evidence_needed: A working official depth URL or a licensed snap-count feed.

rows.question: Do our originated lines beat the closing line?
rows.decision_blocked: Whether to bet, publish, or sell any line.
rows.known: Answered: no. Holdout 2017-2025 margin MAE is 10.392 for the model versus 9.871 for the closing line; total MAE 11.971 vs 10.470. The market is the better forecast.

rows.question: Can 2026 player props be priced?
rows.decision_blocked: Prop singles, prop combos and any player-level strategy.
rows.known: Blocked. No authorized 2026 player-level feed and no archived prop prices are in scope. No value is published.
rows.missing: A licensed player-stat and prop-price feed with timestamps.
rows.evidence_needed: Contract with a data provider; sample file with historical prop lines.

rows.question: How correlated are same-game parlay legs?
rows.decision_blocked: SGP pricing and whether a combo is mispriced.
rows.known: Partially answered for game markets. Favourite-cover vs under phi = 0.0117 (n=3,291, 95% CI -0.0225 to 0.0459): effectively independent. Player-leg correlations are blocked.
rows.missing: Player-level legs and archived SGP prices.
rows.evidence_needed: Q-07 feed plus SGP price snapshots.

rows.question: Which starting-quarterback changes are confirmed for Week 10?
rows.decision_blocked: Quarterback-adjusted lines.
rows.known: Answered for four teams. SEA: Darnold out, Lock starts (article body read). CLE: Watson starts (roundup). ARI: Beck starts (roundup). MIA: McCord in line for first start (headline only).
rows.missing: Confirmation of the Miami change from the article body; Baltimore's replacement.
rows.evidence_needed: Read the Miami article; official Baltimore depth statement.

rows.question: Is Lamar Jackson on injured reserve, and who starts for Baltimore?
rows.decision_blocked: Baltimore's line; the integrity of the injury page.
rows.known: Contradiction found. NFL.com's Nov 5 roundup headline says Baltimore officially placed Jackson on IR; the Week 10 injury page lists Baltimore as 'No Injuries Reported'. No replacement starter is named on that page.
rows.missing: A current official statement resolving the contradiction.
rows.evidence_needed: NFL.com transaction entry or Ravens official announcement.

rows.question: How many players carry a formal game designation at capture time?
rows.decision_blocked: Any 'who is out' dashboard claim.
rows.known: Answered: six league-wide (2 WAS, 1 NYG, 3 NE). Everyone else has practice status only. The official page updates later in the week and again before kickoff.

rows.question: May this repository redistribute NFL scores and page extracts?
rows.decision_blocked: Publishing a data product; mirroring official content.
rows.known: Not answered. NFL.com terms were located but not legally reviewed; the historical archive carries its own upstream licence. No redistribution clearance was obtained.
rows.missing: Legal review and the archive's exact licence terms.

rows.question: Is a paid or prize-based prediction competition lawful where the owner resides (Alberta, Canada)?
rows.decision_blocked: Any monetary reward, leaderboard prize or public contest.
rows.known: Not answered. Rewards are therefore non-monetary reputation points only, with no cash and no pooled stakes.
rows.missing: Jurisdictional legal advice; provincial gaming rules.

rows.question: Can rewards be monetary, and who funds them?
rows.decision_blocked: Reward design; whether to advertise a prize.
rows.known: Currently non-monetary by design (see gates.json). No prize pool is funded.

rows.question: What sample size is enough to call a strategy skilled?
rows.decision_blocked: Promoting any strategy above Bronze.
rows.known: Project-defined, not official: >=300 settled holdout bets across >=3 seasons, plus bootstrap lower bound > 0 and a placebo p < 0.05 adjusted for multiple trials. At a 52.4% break-even rate, hundreds of bets are needed before a 2-3% edge is distinguishable from noise.
rows.missing: An agreed false-positive budget from the owner.
rows.evidence_needed: Owner decision; power calculation for the target edge.

rows.question: What is the staking plan and bankroll unit?
rows.decision_blocked: Any ROI that maps to money; risk of ruin.
rows.known: Not defined. All results are in flat 1-unit stakes, which is a measurement convention, not advice.
rows.missing: Bankroll, unit size, maximum exposure, stop-loss.

rows.question: Who has final authority over a decision, and how often is it reviewed?
rows.decision_blocked: Accepting any suggestion; resolving D1-D3.
rows.known: Not defined. Suggestions stay 'proposed' until a named owner records a decision.

rows.question: Which of the five NFL workspaces is canonical?
rows.decision_blocked: Navigation, SEO, and which numbers a reader should trust.
rows.known: Not decided. This build adds nfl-hub/ as a sixth and does not edit the other four. The four publish different lines and two cite dead URLs.

rows.question: What counts as success: ROI, closing-line value, or calibration?
rows.decision_blocked: Leaderboard rules and whether a strategy is 'good'.
rows.known: Not decided. This build reports all three; the model is calibrated within roughly five percentage points in each bin but has no edge versus the line.

rows.question: How long must a strategy run forward before it is trusted?
rows.decision_blocked: Any claim stronger than 'provisional'.
rows.known: Gate G8 requires at least one full prospective season. None has been completed, so nothing can be Gold.
rows.missing: A start date for the forward log.
rows.evidence_needed: Timestamped forward predictions for a season.

rows.question: What is the injury-impact hypothesis, and how will it be tested?
rows.decision_blocked: Adding injuries to the model without guessing.
rows.known: Not tested. No historical injury dataset could be downloaded in this environment (the archive's release assets are unreachable from the sandbox), so no injury coefficient is estimated.
rows.missing: Historical injury data aligned to games; a pre-registered effect size.
rows.evidence_needed: Dataset plus pre-registration, then a holdout test.

rows.question: If no official depth chart exists, what is a defensible definition of 'starter'?
rows.decision_blocked: The 2nd/3rd/4th-string deficiency index.
rows.known: Not answered. Candidate definitions (first snap on offense/defence, >50% snap share) require snap counts, which are not in scope.
rows.missing: Snap-count data and an agreed threshold.
rows.evidence_needed: Snap-count feed; owner approval of a definition.

rows.question: Which team code convention applies (LA vs LAR, AZ vs ARI)?
rows.decision_blocked: Joining any official table to the archive.
rows.known: Answered. The archive uses LA and AZ; NFL.com uses LAR and ARI. A mapping is applied and documented; no rows were dropped.

rows.question: What is a real parlay price, and does the book adjust for correlation?
rows.decision_blocked: Parlay and SGP profitability.
rows.known: Assumed only. A standard 2-team payout of +164 is used and flagged; no archived parlay price exists. G7 therefore fails for every parlay strategy.

rows.question: Should individual picks be published publicly?
rows.decision_blocked: Site content policy.
rows.known: This build publishes lines and model probabilities with explicit 'not advice' labels, and no stake advice. Public pick publication has not been reviewed for regulatory exposure.

rows.question: What is the data budget and refresh cadence?
rows.decision_blocked: Choice of vendor; freshness of every table.
rows.known: No budget is defined. The current snapshot is manual/one-off and is labelled as such.

rows.question: Are the project's gate thresholds calibrated to any external standard?
rows.decision_blocked: Defensibility of the pass/fail line.
rows.known: No. They are project-defined research choices (n>=300, 60% positive seasons, p<0.05), not NFL or regulatory standards.
